'''"Iron Shackle" Y'ia''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Y'ia was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Zel'iphian Slave Traders Guild]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain "Iron Shackle" Y'ia frequently piloted a [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="SWG:DS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCivilian.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Captain "Iron Shackle" Y'ia]]
Y'ia appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Captain "Iron Shackle" Y'ia was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. Captain Y'ia was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Zel'iphian starfighters in the Dantooine system.<ref name="SWG:DS" />
